draft.title: Place and space
card: A part of the Earth's surface that has meaning to people. It might be a street, a beach or a whole town, and it can mean different things to different people.
How things are arranged and spread across the Earth's surface. It asks where things are, how far apart they are and what pattern they make.
A geographer studying place asks what a location means to people. A geographer studying space asks how features are distributed and arranged.
One location can be studied both ways. A beach is a place when we ask what it means to the locals who swim there. It is space when we map where beaches lie along a coast.
draft.remember: Place is about meaning to people. Space is about arrangement and spread.

a.q: Which question is mainly about space?
opts: How are the town's libraries spread across the suburb?
Why does the old pier matter to the town's families?
What does the creek mean to the local Elders?
How do students feel about their school oval?
a.why: Asking how libraries are spread across a suburb is about arrangement and distribution, which is space. The other three ask about meaning or feeling, which belong to place. The old pier is tempting, but it asks why a site matters to people.
a.clue: Look for the question about where things are and how they are spread.

b.q: Mei is studying Bondi Beach. She interviews long-time locals about what the beach means to them. Which idea is she mainly studying?
opts: Place, because she is studying the meaning people give it
Space, because she is studying a location on a coast
Space, because she is collecting data from many people
Place, because beaches are natural features of the coast
b.why: Mei asks what the beach means to people, so she is studying place. Bondi is on a coast, but a location alone does not make a study about space. Space would be about how beaches are arranged or spread out.
b.clue: Focus on what Mei is asking the locals about.

a.best: How are the town's libraries spread across the suburb?

b.best: Place, because she is studying the meaning people give it

check.summary: No problems found. Both questions have one clearly right answer that matches the card, and the explanations agree with it.
